description: Amazon A+ 长图 profile 模板。脚本按 --profile 加载并写入 detail-plan.json 的 sections 字段。每段 id 在 profile 内唯一，frame_objective 与 prompt_focus 作为默认值，agent 可在 detail-plan.json 中覆盖。

sections.goal: Hero 首屏：1 秒内建立品类识别、品牌感与主购买理由
sections.frame_objective: Hero advertising banner that establishes brand and primary selling reason within 1 second
sections.prompt_focus: large product visual occupying 40-60% of canvas, bold benefit headline, brand logo, premium category background
sections.transition_in: 首屏直接奠定视觉基调，无需承接
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留可延展背景与装饰元素，承接核心卖点段

sections.goal: 核心卖点 Icon 卡片：3-5 个利益型卖点
sections.frame_objective: Communicate 3-5 user benefits with icon cards
sections.prompt_focus: rounded info cards with consistent icons, benefit titles ≤ 4 words and explanations ≤ 12 words, optional small product accents
sections.transition_in: 顶部承接 Hero 的色板与纹理，色相平滑过渡
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留卡片色块或细线装饰，承接产品单体展示

sections.goal: 产品单体高级展示，提升信任
sections.frame_objective: Showcase the product itself with clean premium styling and minimal labels
sections.prompt_focus: single product hero shot with clean background, soft shadows, 2-3 short labels and a brand-tone slogan
sections.transition_in: 顶部承接卖点卡片色块，过渡到展示背景
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留产品阴影或纹理，承接拆解段

sections.goal: 功能 / 成分 / 结构拆解
sections.frame_objective: Explain why the product is better with annotated close-ups
sections.prompt_focus: product close-ups with refined callout lines, ≤ 5 annotation points, optional exploded or cross-section view
sections.transition_in: 顶部承接展示段背景，过渡到拆解视角
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留功能图标或线稿，承接使用步骤

sections.goal: 使用步骤，降低理解成本
sections.frame_objective: Walk through 3-4 simple usage steps
sections.prompt_focus: step-by-step layout with numbered cards 01/02/03/04, real-life small photos, image-to-text ratio 7:3
sections.transition_in: 顶部承接拆解段图标系统
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留生活化场景过渡，承接 lifestyle 段

sections.goal: 真实生活方式场景，建立代入感
sections.frame_objective: Show the product in real human/pet/home/outdoor usage
sections.prompt_focus: authentic lifestyle scene with visible product, natural emotion, clean background, one emotional headline
sections.transition_in: 顶部承接步骤段的色板
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留场景余韵或装饰，承接性能可视化
shared_elements: 真实人物 / 宠物 / 场景

sections.goal: 性能 / 功效可视化
sections.frame_objective: Translate abstract advantages into visual evidence
sections.prompt_focus: simple bar / curve / progress / before-after / icon-ring visualization, conceptual data only when not user-supplied
sections.transition_in: 顶部承接生活方式段色板
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留对比线索，承接 Why-Us 段

sections.goal: Why Choose Us 对比，建立购买理由
sections.frame_objective: Show this product vs ordinary product, generic comparison only
sections.prompt_focus: compact comparison block ≤ 5 rows or 4 reasons-to-choose-us cards, highlight ours visually
sections.transition_in: 顶部承接性能可视化背景
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留过渡到规格段

sections.goal: 规格 / 参数 / 成分 / 营养表
sections.frame_objective: Final rational confirmation with category-appropriate specs
sections.prompt_focus: left product/package image + right specs/nutrition/supplement-facts/size-guide table, clean readable typography
sections.transition_in: 顶部承接 Why-Us 段，进入理性确认氛围
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留过渡到包装展示

sections.goal: 包装 / 配件 / 套装展示
sections.frame_objective: Show what the buyer actually receives
sections.prompt_focus: neatly arranged package and accessories with consistent perspective, clear package text, no clutter
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留信任元素或品牌符号

sections.goal: 用户评价 / 信任背书（按 Review Switch 处理）
sections.frame_objective: Reinforce trust with reviews, brand promise, or quality icons
sections.prompt_focus: review-style cards with stars and avatars OR brand promise iconography; never fabricate platform marks
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留品牌色或情绪过渡
shared_elements: 评价卡片或品牌承诺图标

sections.goal: Closing 情绪收尾，强化品牌记忆
sections.frame_objective: Final emotional closing with one strong headline only
sections.prompt_focus: final hero-like product shot with lifestyle background, brand logo, single emotional headline, optional minimal CTA
sections.transition_in: 顶部承接信任段，过渡到品牌氛围
sections.transition_out: 图像收尾，无需为后续段预留

sections.goal: Hero 首屏
sections.frame_objective: Hero advertising banner
sections.prompt_focus: large product visual, bold benefit headline, brand logo, premium category background
sections.transition_in: 首屏直接奠定视觉基调
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留可延展背景，承接卖点段

sections.goal: 核心卖点 Icon 卡片
sections.frame_objective: Communicate 3-5 user benefits with icon cards
sections.prompt_focus: rounded info cards with consistent icons, short benefit titles and concise explanations
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留卡片色块，承接拆解段

sections.goal: 功能 / 成分 / 结构拆解
sections.frame_objective: Annotated close-ups explaining why it is better
sections.prompt_focus: close-up product views with refined callout lines, ≤ 5 annotation points
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留装饰，承接步骤

sections.goal: 使用步骤
sections.frame_objective: Walk through 3-4 simple usage steps
sections.prompt_focus: numbered step layout 01/02/03/04 with real small photos
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留过渡到生活方式

sections.goal: 真实生活方式场景
sections.frame_objective: Show product in real usage scene
sections.prompt_focus: authentic lifestyle scene with visible product and emotional headline
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留过渡到 Why-Us

sections.goal: Why Choose Us 对比
sections.frame_objective: Generic comparison highlighting our advantages
sections.prompt_focus: ≤ 5 row comparison or 4 reasons-to-choose cards, visually highlight ours
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留过渡到规格表

sections.goal: 规格 / 成分 / 营养表
sections.frame_objective: Rational confirmation with specs / nutrition table
sections.prompt_focus: product or package on the left, table on the right, clean typography
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留过渡到品牌收尾

sections.goal: Closing 情绪收尾
sections.frame_objective: Final emotional closing with one strong headline
sections.prompt_focus: final hero-like shot with lifestyle background, brand logo, single emotional headline
sections.transition_in: 顶部承接规格段，进入品牌氛围
sections.transition_out: 图像收尾

sections.goal: 首屏展示商品系列、品牌识别和核心利益点
sections.frame_objective: Brand-led hero banner
sections.prompt_focus: large product visual, brand identity, core benefit headline
sections.transition_in: 首屏直接奠定视觉基调
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留可延展背景，承接卖点段

sections.goal: 核心卖点矩阵，使用卡片或图标组合
sections.frame_objective: 3-5 benefit cards with icons
sections.prompt_focus: rounded info cards with consistent icons and short copy
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留卡片色块，承接品质故事

sections.goal: 品质、来源、工艺或可信证据
sections.frame_objective: Trust-leaning quality / origin / craftsmanship narrative
sections.prompt_focus: quality story imagery with material macros, origin shots, or process visuals
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留过渡到产品特写

sections.goal: 单品特写和关键卖点
sections.frame_objective: Single product premium showcase
sections.prompt_focus: single product hero shot with soft shadows and 2-3 short labels
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留过渡到生活方式

sections.goal: 使用场景、产地、使用方式或用户收益
sections.frame_objective: Lifestyle / scenario coverage
sections.prompt_focus: real lifestyle scene or origin imagery showing product use
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留过渡到规格表

sections.goal: 规格、成分、参数或购买前确认，只写已确认事实
sections.frame_objective: Specs / nutrition / supplement / size guide table
sections.prompt_focus: left product/package + right specs table with clean typography
sections.transition_out: 底部 15% 预留过渡到品牌收尾

sections.goal: 品牌收尾和信任感，不写强促销话术
sections.frame_objective: Brand closing with one final headline
sections.prompt_focus: final brand-tone closing with product and lifestyle background, single headline
sections.transition_out: 图像收尾

single-modules.label: Amazon Basic / Premium / Brand Story single modules

sections.goal: Amazon Basic A+ 模块工作稿，970x300
sections.frame_objective: Basic A+ module image at 970x300
sections.prompt_focus: Basic A+ horizontal module with hero benefit and supporting visual at 970x300
sections.transition_out: 独立模块

sections.goal: Amazon Premium A+ 模块工作稿，1464x600
sections.frame_objective: Premium A+ module image at 1464x600
sections.prompt_focus: Premium A+ horizontal module at 1464x600 with strong product hero and editorial copy
sections.transition_out: 独立模块

sections.goal: Amazon Brand Story 卡片工作稿，1500x500
sections.frame_objective: Brand Story card at 1500x500
sections.prompt_focus: Brand Story card at 1500x500 with brand promise and category-aligned imagery
sections.transition_out: 独立模块
